about_the_game:
⚡ Instant Action

Start a new run in seconds and get ready for intense post-apocalyptic warfare!

You begin with a simple rifle loaded with ammo and some health points… and you’ll face your first enemy almost immediately.

Each time you clear a level:

  • 🔫 Loot a new weapon (skip it or equip it)

  • 💰 Gain money

  • 📈 Choose a stat upgrade

But beware: the next level is always tougher — more enemies, more health, more danger.

🔥 Loot, Loot, Loot!

Pistols, rifles, shotguns, flamethrowers, grenades… and more — each weapon is available in 5 quality tiers.
Be fast, be accurate, don’t lose HP — the loot will reward your skill!

Spend your money on core stats boosts, support stats… or save your gains for your next run.

Like any good roguelike, you won’t start from scratch every time: upgrade your stats, unlock new lootable weapons and abilities, and grow stronger with every attempt.

🏆 Classes, Perks & Mastery

Poly Frenzy features 5 unique classes, each with their own dedicated progression tree and perks.
The more you play a class, the more powerful it becomes — try them all and discover your favorite playstyle!

🌍 10 Maps, 2 Modes

Take on 10 different maps in two solo modes:

  • Classic Mode — Beat all 10 escalating challenges to climb the leaderboard.

  • Survival Mode — Pick a map and survive wave after wave… until death.

🤜🤛 Solo or Coop

The game is tough in solo… and even tougher in coop.
Play with friends and test the limits of your friendship — because loot is unique and money is shared!
Want to troll? Blow the squad’s hard-earned money on a giant nuke… just to obliterate the very last enemy for nothing. 💣
